references/method.md 'Step 3' and 'Step 1 — Classify funding' do not address timing for a multi-year unconditional award whose promise predates the period (G2, January 2024): recognition when promised versus when received is left unstated.

references/method.md 'Step 6 — Output', Sheet 5 requires the roll-forward 'reconciled to the net asset accounts in the ledger' with no upload-path rule for when the opening restricted balance is not split by grant or the uploaded balances do not balance.
